latest_release.name: v0.5.0
latest_release.body:
## [0.5.0](https://github.com/avante-corp/avante.nvim/compare/v0.5.0...v0.5.0) (2026-10-31)

This release starts 2 refactoring:
- move more of the backend code to rust libraries: this release moves ACP support from homemade lua code to a rust library relying on the official ACP SDK. The goal is to make the backend more robust/featureful while keeping the ability to hack advanced stuff with lua. There is no point in redeveloping the whole backend from scratch, with all the bugs it entails. This frees maintainer time to focus on the actual neovim integration. 0.6 will move the classical LLM API backend to rust as well. This means the rust libraries are likely to evolve more often so we encourage users to pin to a tagged release instead of using the nighlty version if you want to avoid recompiling libraries on every update. AvanteBuild now accepts a version like this `:AvanteBuild --version=v0.5.0`, contrary to its name, it downloads the libraries rather than compiling (naming to be fixed).
- a redesign of the avante commands from `:AvanteXXX` to `:Avante xxx` as per https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/32263 

On the CI front, we provide a nix cache avante-nvim.cachix.org and started doing release through the "release-please" workflow, hopefully making it easier to create more frequent releases. 


The generated changelog contains some already released changes for some reason. Might be new in case you missed it or a welcome refresher ;)
 
### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* dont include out of cwd templates
* **rag:** change default folder from /tmp to $XDG_STATE_HOME
* **rag:** dont read log level from env
* **rag:** dont read port from env anymore
* change default header to show current model
* replace plenary.curl with vim.net for web_search
* rename rag-service -> avante-rag-service
* select models for current provider only
* better respect of XDG standard
* deprecate dressing.nvim input provider
* move some of the sidebar setup code to ftplugin/
* bump required neovim from 0.10 to 0.11
* use vim.ui.select for AvanteSwitchProvider ([#2935](https://github.com/avante-corp/avante.nvim/issues/2935))

### Features

* **acp:** add :Avante acp sessions to list and resume agent sessions ([99ee143](https://github.com/avante-corp/avante.nvim/commit/99ee14397d2106e7ec6494dc579797127d3367e3))
